pages.name: Four Knights: Rubinstein, 5.Ba4
pages.notes: The overview had the bishop pressing a c6-knight that is on d4; plan 1 challenged it with c3 (the c3-knight blocks the pawn) and a d4 push onto Black's knight; plan 2 called the f8-bishop light-squared and had ...c6 'challenge' the a4-bishop. Rewrote all three.

pages.name: Four Knights: Rubinstein, 5.Ba4 Nxf3+
pages.notes: The overview said Black cedes the bishop pair (a pair of knights is traded; both sides keep their bishops); plan 3 had the queen already on f3 and going to h5; plan 4 aimed to trade a bishop pair that doesn't exist. Rewrote the overview and plans 1, 3 and 4.

pages.name: Four Knights: Rubinstein, 5.Nxe5
pages.notes: needs-research: plan 3 pushes d4 onto Black's d4-knight. Two rewrites were rejected by the reviewer (after 5...Qe7, neither the retreat to f3 nor 6.f4 keeps the extra pawn, and the d4-knight usually takes on b5), so the old text is kept and the reference added to the skips. Plan 4 called ...Qe7 a pin (the e4-pawn is in the way); rewritten around ...Qe7 hitting e5. British spelling in plan 1.

pages.name: Four Knights: Rubinstein, Exchange Variation, 8...Qe5+
pages.notes: Plan 1 traded queens on e2 before White has put the queen there and called the f8-bishop light-squared; plan 2 credited White with central space and no bishop pair exists. Rewrote both. (A first version called the endgame favourable for Black and the d-file open; the reviewer rejected both.)

pages.name: Four Knights: Spanish, Classical, Marshall Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a Ba4-c2 route through the c2-pawn; now Ba4, Nd3 and e5. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Bernstein Variation, 4 Knights
pages.notes: The overview called the b4-bishop light-squared and the b-file open (half-open); plan 1 had f4 behind the f3-knight; plan 3 targeted a c4-pawn and ...Na5 that don't exist; plan 4 prepared e4-e5 with Black's pawn on e5. Rewrote the overview and all four plans.

pages.name: Blackburne Attack, 4 Knights
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...d5 with White's knight on d5; now ...Nxd5. British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Four Knights Game: Spanish Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 targeted a c4-pawn White doesn't have yet; rewrote it. British spelling in the overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Four Knights Game: Spanish Variation, Double Spanish
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted 'the c3-knight' via Nd2-f1-g3; now Ne2-g3. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Four Knights Game: Spanish Variation, Janowski Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a knight route starting from g1 (the knight is on f3); plan 2 had ...Ne7-g6 for a knight on c6. Rewrote both (the first rewrite kept the old claim that a g6-knight presses e4, which the reviewer rejected). British spelling in the overview.
